result.title: JuniperGrid 5.5: official snapshot retention reference
result.text:
# JuniperGrid 5.5 storage reference

For the default deployment profile in release 5.5, snapshot retention is 70 calendar days (retention_days=70).
The timer and importer defaults are maintained in the separate community compatibility reference for this exact release.
Retention is measured in days, not hours. Explicit tenant overrides are outside this default-profile reference.

result.title: JuniperGrid 5.5: checkpoint and parallel import defaults
result.text:
# JuniperGrid 5.5 community compatibility reference

Scope: the default deployment profile of JuniperGrid release 5.5.
The default checkpoint interval is 16 minutes (checkpoint_minutes=16).
The default maximum number of parallel import jobs is 11 (max_parallel_imports=11).
The official snapshot-retention reference contains the retention default.
These values concern defaults; tenant overrides and older releases are excluded.

Community background note. This reference describes the default deployment profile. Storage retention, checkpoint scheduling, and import concurrency are separate configuration concepts. A tenant can have an override without changing the release defaults. Historical product notes describe their own versions. The glossary explains terminology and contains no release values. The support community maintains descriptive documentation for administrators.

result.text:
# Archived JuniperGrid legacy profile

This archive does NOT describe JuniperGrid 5.5. It documents an obsolete pre-release profile only.
Historical snapshot retention: 7 days. Historical checkpoint interval: 60 minutes. Historical maximum parallel imports: 1.
Current defaults must be obtained from documents for the exact release.

result.title: JuniperGrid: storage and import terminology
result.text:
# JuniperGrid glossary

Snapshot retention is the age limit for automatic snapshots. A checkpoint interval is elapsed wall-clock time between checkpoints. Maximum parallel imports counts simultaneous import jobs. This glossary contains no numeric release defaults.
